assumptions: 2019 segment mix and unit time remain representative of 2022.
Historical 42% case-to-SAR conversion borrowed from 13-bank industry study.
Twenty minutes initial case review, three minutes continuing, 25 minutes declining a case; batch recordkeeping five vs discrete fifteen minutes.

reconstruction_issues: 2019 compensation and rounded 1.98-hour average reused without updated segment mix.
Item13 reports labor rather than separately assessing nonlabor cost.
Industry 15-large-bank estimate21.41h rejected as nongeneralizable; this does not validate1.98h for all segments.
methods_worth_testing: Model nonfiling decisions and case-review funnels, not only submitted reports.
Assess consultation sample coverage and task scope explicitly; avoid treating absence of earlier objection as validation.
